name: ADOBMD GUI
author: Acxel Orozco
description: Complete Graphic User Interface for Advanced Development of Binary Molecular Dynamics: 3D visualizer for ADOBMD data, molecule converter (CIF/PDB/SDF/XYZ), and importers for OpenKIM archives, VASP (POSCAR/OUTCAR), Quantum ESPRESSO (pw.x) and ORCA (Hessian + MBIS/CHELPG -> molecule force field).
